title: picard_residue_quotient_model_homology
statement:
theorem picard_residue_quotient_model_homology
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v}, HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (E : schemeDerivedCategory W) (w : W)
    (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (p : Ideal Γ(W, U)) [p.IsPrime]
    (hp : p = RingHom.ker (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ) :
    let F : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤
      ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U) :=
      SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
    letI : F.Additive := inferInstanceAs
      ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive)
    let T := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
    letI : T.Additive := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj _).left_adjoint_additive
    let C := ((F ⋙ T).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K
    Nonempty (affineResidueCycleHomology W U p K ≃+ C.homology 1)

proof.text: Use hp, IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_hom_apply and IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff to identify p with the prime of the affine chart at w. Apply affine_residue_scalar_transport to identify residue scalar extension, after restricting its scalar field, with extension along section evaluation.

The identity on the residue field is linear from its native section-ring action to the action in restrictScalars, by Algebra.smul_def. TensorProduct.congr gives the term identifications. Tensor induction and naturality of scalar transport prove that the resulting additive equivalences commute with every differential.

Restrict the degree-one additive equivalence and its inverse to the outgoing kernels. The degree-zero equivalence and differential compatibility identify the incoming boundary subgroups in both directions. QuotientAddGroup.congr descends this cycle equivalence to the boundary quotients, including nonzero boundaries.

Apply ShortComplex.moduleCatHomologyIso to the explicit short complex C.sc′ 0 1 2, and HomologicalComplex.homologyIsoSc′ to identify its homology with C.homology 1. Compose these additive equivalences with the quotient comparison.
